name: create_issue
description: Create a new issue in Linear.

description.description: Optional. The issue description, in Markdown.

assignee.description: Optional. The assignee's name, or "me" for the account the API key belongs to.

priority.description: Optional. One of: none, urgent, high, medium, low.

project.description: Optional. The name of the project to add the issue to.

labels.description: Optional. Comma-separated label names, for example "Bug, P1". Each must exist; an unknown name fails.

due_date.description: Optional. Due date as an ISO date, for example "2026-09-30".
